about: Smart stream choice words (plans/m13-stream-choice.md 3.7, 3.9, 3.11, 4.4, 4.5), shared by the web, Android and Apple apps. A line's details are parts joined with ", "; a part shows only when every field it names is known, and the joined details start with a capital letter. Counts use the plurals below and group thousands with a comma. Sizes use 1024-based units, as addons print them: one decimal under 100 GB with a trailing .0 dropped, whole numbers from 100 GB, MB under 1 GB. Mbit/s are whole numbers. The device line shows the HTTP speed with a streaming service account or without the engine, else the torrent speed; a speed with 0 samples is not said at all (no estimate): the device line names the network alone and mayPause leaves its details out. The empty section is why nothing can play, by the snapshot's empty.kind (plans/play-every-version.md 2a), with its one action (empty.action): the kind's action words, or for playFromDevice the unreachable kind's playFromDevice; a kind with no action shows its line alone; a kind's row is what each of its dimmed rows says in place of its own line. The page section is the Versions page's own words and the player section what the player says while a version starts; neither ever names an addon. The kind section is the Versions page's kind chips (plans/plugins-and-marketplace.md 4.2): All, then one chip per entry of the snapshot's kinds (torrent, direct, debrid), shown from two kinds on and kept while the page is open; a kind chip shows its count of rows and its spoken label is a11y with the versions plural. The debrid chip says its entry's service, else debrid. Under a kind (selectedKind) the card's kicker is best.<kind>, best.service when the debrid entry names a service. notStarted is the player's: its budget ran out; chooseAnother is also the loading screen's and the stalled frame's button.

question.title: How should Momotus pick what to play?
question.lead: You can change this later in Settings, under Stream choice.

fast.label: Start fast
fast.text: Smaller files that many people share. Starts in seconds.

best.text: The best version your screen and connection can play.

settings.title: Stream choice
settings.lede: How Momotus picks the version to play. Every version stays in the list, so you can always pick another.
